19135: São João do Rio do Peixe

it.txt: Era presidente da Assembleia Legislativa e assumiu o governo como interino em 05/04/2026, depois que o governador Wilson Lima e o vice Tadeu de Souza renunciaram (04/04/2026) para disputar a eleição; em 04/05/2026 foi eleito governador pelos deputados estaduais (eleição indireta) para completar o mandato
it.txt_en: He was the president of the Legislative Assembly (state parliament). He became acting governor on April 5, 2026, after Governor Wilson Lima and Vice Governor Tadeu de Souza resigned (April 4, 2026) to run in the election. On May 4, 2026, the state deputies (members of the state parliament) chose him as governor in an indirect election (a vote by the lawmakers, not by the people) to finish the term.
